title: 第23章 各方震动第24章 天梯登顶王之门扉
content_zh:
位于王都北边，有着一座占地无比广袤的修炼武府，便是第一修炼圣地——天元武府！
天元武府，卧虎藏龙，强者无数，不知道蛰伏了多少强者，这一刻也被惊动，远眺斗塔。
同样，也很想知道，是哪位天骄闯进人榜前十了。
人榜前十名，已经足足有近十年没有更迭过名单了。
因为但凡前十者，都是传说中打破了七九极限的存在，无比妖孽。
饶是大赵王朝天才不少，但也有近十年时间，也只有那么三人踏足人榜前十了。
一下子，无数人都在那里疯狂讨论。
王都郊外，一座占地广阔的演武广场上，超过三十万的士兵正在兵演。
一个个士兵天灵盖上有着浓郁的血气化作狼烟，滚滚冲天，声势相当骇人。
此间，一道身影格外魁梧巍峨的身影，立在一座高台上，血气尤为惊人，竟然压盖过了十万大军的血气，血气如光柱般瞩目。
仅仅只是站在那里，便是予人一种不可撼动之感。
此人，便是大赵王朝赫赫有名的北疆大将——张庆芝！
这一刻，他目光遥望王都内的那座斗塔，露出一抹讶然之色：“居然有人击败了我当年留在试炼天地内的那道虚影。”
“虽然当初我不过是六十四牛之力，但能够击败我之烙印者，显然后来者至少是同层次，甚至力量更强，不知道到底是谁呢？”
“看来我大赵王朝再度诞生出新的妖孽了，这让本座很期待。”
身在试炼天地中的秦玄，并没知道因为自己击败了人榜第十的张庆芝的武道烙印，所引起的轩然大波，惊动了整个大赵王朝。
粉碎了人榜第十名的榜上者烙印后，成片成片的光雨落下，携带着丝丝缕缕的法则之力，没入他的身体内。
不但让秦玄力量得到了一定的提升，而且也加快了剑魔真血的融合。
接连击败一位位人榜天骄，沐浴光雨，以及加快融合了剑魔真血后，秦玄力量也再度打破极限，从八十九牛之力迅速提升，步入了九十三牛之力。
“没想到击败人榜前十武道烙印，给予的奖励真不少。

不知道击败了所有前十，能否让我达到九十九牛之力呢？”
秦玄也不免有些兴奋了。
他唰地一声，迅速登梯。
不久后，在第六百五十二级上，遇到了人榜第九的武道烙印，更强于人榜第十的张庆芝武道烙印一截之上。
“吾名魏峰——”
轰！
话声刚落，这个人榜第九的武道烙印还没来得及出手，就被秦玄直接轰爆成灰，再度有着成片的光雨落下，没入他体内。
外界。
世人虽然早有所猜测，但当听到塔钟再度敲响，见到人榜石碑上的名字更迭的那一刻，依旧忍不住震惊。
要知道，那可是人榜前十，都是大赵王朝历年来有得数的妖孽之辈。
而且人榜前十可是将近五年未曾排名更迭过了，今日接连被秦玄给更迭了两次。
更为重要的是，从击败人榜第十到击败人榜第九，这才过去了多久。
显然，对他来说，人榜第九并不是很难对付，否则不可能这么快。
但很快，钟声再度敲响。
人榜第八被击败了。
几个呼吸后。
人榜第七也被击败了。
然后，不多时，人榜第六也被击败了。
举世震怖！
所有人都很想知道，秦玄究竟能走到哪一步？
content_en:
Located in the north of the royal capital, there is a martial arts training palace that covers an extremely vast area. It is the first holy land of cultivation - Tianyuan Martial Arts Palace!
Tianyuan Martial Mansion, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, there are countless strong men. I don’t know how many strong men are dormant. I was also alarmed at this moment, looking at the Dou Tower from a distance.
Likewise, I also want to know which genius has made it into the top ten.
The top ten people on the list have not changed for nearly ten years.
Because the top ten are all legendary beings who have broken the limit of seven or nine, and are extremely evil.
Although there are many geniuses in the Zhao Dynasty, in the past ten years, only three people have been in the top ten of the list.
All of a sudden, countless people were discussing wildly there.
On the outskirts of the royal capital, in a vast martial arts square, more than 300,000 soldiers were conducting military exercises.
The soldiers' Tianling Caps with rich blood turned into smoke, billowing into the sky, and the momentum was quite terrifying.
Here, a particularly tall and towering figure stood on a high platform. His blood energy was particularly astonishing. It actually overwhelmed the blood energy of an army of 100,000 people. His blood energy was as eye-catching as a beam of light.
Just standing there gives people an unshakable feeling.
This person is Zhang Qingzhi, the famous Northern Xinjiang general of the Zhao Dynasty!
At this moment, he looked at the fighting tower in the royal capital, showing a look of surprise: "Someone actually defeated the phantom that I left in the trial world."
"Although I only had the strength of sixty-four bulls at the beginning, those who can defeat my brand are obviously at least at the same level or even stronger. I wonder who they are?"
"It seems that our Great Zhao Dynasty has given birth to a new monster again, which I am very much looking forward to."
Qin Xuan, who was in the trial world, had no idea that the uproar caused by his defeat of the martial arts brand of Zhang Qingzhi, who was ranked tenth on the list, had shocked the entire Zhao Dynasty.
After shattering the mark of the tenth person on the list, patches of light rain fell down, carrying strands of the power of law and sinking into his body.
Not only did Qin Xuan's strength increase to a certain extent, but it also accelerated the fusion of the Sword Demon's true blood.
After defeating one of the top geniuses one after another, bathing in the light rain, and accelerating the integration of the Sword Demon's true blood, Qin Xuan's strength once again exceeded the limit, rapidly increasing from the power of eighty-nine cows to the power of ninety-three cows.
“I didn’t expect that the rewards given to those who defeated the top ten martial arts brands on the list would be so many.
I wonder if defeating all the top ten will allow me to reach the power of ninety-nine cows? "
Qin Xuan couldn't help but feel a little excited.
With a whoosh, he quickly climbed up the stairs.
Not long after, on the 652nd level, I met the ninth martial arts brand on the popular list, which was a step stronger than the tenth ranked martial arts brand Zhang Qingzhi.
"My name is Wei Feng——"
Boom!
As soon as he finished speaking, before the martial arts brand who ranked ninth on the list could take action, he was directly blasted into ashes by Qin Xuan, and sheets of light rain fell down again and sank into his body.
outside world.
Although the world had already guessed, they still couldn't help but be shocked when they heard the tower bell ringing again and saw the names on the stone tablet changing.
You know, those are the top ten people on the list, and they are all monsters that the Zhao Dynasty has had over the years.
Moreover, the top ten on the list have not been changed in the past five years, and they were changed twice by Qin Xuan today.
More importantly, how long it took for him to go from being tenth on the list of defeated people to ninth on the list of defeated people.
Obviously, for him, being ninth on the list is not difficult to deal with, otherwise it would not be so fast.
But soon, the bell rang again.
Number eight on the list was defeated.
After a few breaths.
The seventh person on the list was also defeated.
Then, not long after, the sixth person on the list was also defeated.
The whole world is shocked!
Everyone wants to know how far Qin Xuan can go?
